title: SBIC Critical Technologies applicant, leverage, performance, and recovery denominator · first pass

sources.title: SBA and DoD Celebrate Successful First Year for the SBIC Critical Technology Initiative
retrieved_facts: More than 100 funds had expressed interest.
Twenty-two funds had submitted formal applications since the initiative began accepting applications in fall 2023.
Thirteen funds were approved for Green Light or licensing as of 2024-10-22.
The thirteen funds planned to raise 2.8 billion dollars in private capital and were eligible for SBA-guaranteed leverage after licensing.
The program distinguished interest, application, approval, licensing, and access to guaranteed leverage.

sources.title: DoD and SBA Publish Names of First 18 Licensed and Green Light Approved Funds
retrieved_facts: The first published cohort contained eighteen funds.
Seventeen funds were publicly named and one fund identity was withheld under SBA policy.
Seven funds were described as fully licensed and investing at the 2025-01-17 checkpoint.
Published cohort projections were not realized investment, performance, repayment, or public recovery.

sources.title: Investment Policy Statement, Small Business Investment Company Critical Technology Initiative
retrieved_facts: The policy statement describes portfolio objectives, SBA and DoD governance, risk management, monitoring, and reporting.
Program-level monitoring and leverage authority do not disclose every applicant, fund-level instrument, draw, portfolio outcome, or repayment.
